title: Surjectivity in the critical coimage cohomology degree
statement: Fix a prime ell, an affine scheme X, a bound d, and a commutative condensed ring Lambda isomorphic to Z_ell, O_E, Q_ell or E, with E/Q_ell finite [sk-def-localizing-closure, def-pc-scheme]. Use ordinary internal modules on the small pro-etale site and ordinary uncompleted derived sections [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention, sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull, def-sfb-condensed-module-sections]. Suppose every affine etale V -> X has torsion etale cohomological dimension at most d [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-etale-morphism, def-sc-etale-torsion-cd]. Let M,N lie in the weak Serre coproduct hull of finite constant scalar-model constructible modules [sk-def-sfb-constructible], with H^r RΓ(M[0]) = H^r RΓ(N[0]) = 0 for r>d+2, and f:M -> N any actual module map. Then the map H^(d+2) RΓ(M[0]) -> H^(d+2) RΓ(coim(f)[0]) induced by the actual coimage quotient map is an epimorphism. This asserts nothing in other degrees.

proof.text: At the critical degree d+2, retain the map from the source to its actual coimage in the strict relation comparison on affine weakly contractible pro-etale charts. The torsion etale bound makes the critical obstruction a boundary in the finite quotient relation complexes. For integral coefficients compare the compatible boundaries through the countable inverse-limit triangle, rather than assuming surjectivity of individual quotient transition maps. For rational coefficients localize the finite integral relation comparison exactly. Descend the comparison through the open-closed support refinements. The resulting lift of each critical coimage cohomology class to source cohomology proves the asserted epimorphism. This statement concerns this one critical degree only; it gives no bound in higher degrees. It requires the actual relation comparison for arbitrary earlier hull objects, not merely finite-model maps, and assumes no arbitrary completeness.

theorem torsionCd_critical_coimage_surjectivity
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (hΛ :
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℤ_[ℓ])) ∨
      (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E))) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℚ_[ℓ])) ∨
      (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E))))
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (d : ℕ)
    (hcd : ∀ (V : Scheme.{u}) (v : V ⟶ X) [IsAffine V] [Etale v],
      V.HasTorsionEtaleCohomologicalDimensionLE d)
    (M N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hM : ObjectProperty.weakSerreCoproductClosure.{u + 1}
      (IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X) M)
    (hN : ObjectProperty.weakSerreCoproductClosure.{u + 1}
      (IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X) N)
    (hMb : ∀ q : ℤ, (d : ℤ) + 2 < q →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
        ((condensedModuleSections Λ X).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M))))
    (hNb : ∀ q : ℤ, (d : ℤ) + 2 < q →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
        ((condensedModuleSections Λ X).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj N))))
    : Epi ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ ((d : ℤ) + 2)).map
      ((condensedModuleSections Λ X).rightDerivedFunctor.map
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).map (Abelian.coimage.π f))))
